column1: # Seeded UI-state gallery for the visual-QA capture rail.
# One row per named UI state: <name> TAB <space-separated MDX_SHOT_* env>.
# capture_gallery.sh launches the staged app once per state per appearance/a11y
# variant with these vars set, so every frame is deterministic and driven by the
# real views against a real (isolated, worn) kernel. The MDX_SHOT_* hooks are
# inert in the shipping app; they only steer the app into a known state for the
# camera. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# States marked "kernel-data" depend on the seeded snapshot actually containing
# that shape (a running run, a parallel group). When it does not, the app lands
# on the honest nearest surface and the capture manifest records that, rather
# than the rail faking the state.
